[2:02PM] #LagosBadagryExp #TrafficUpdate 

The stretch from Agbara Customs Checkpoint to Iyana Era has good movement. There is moving traffic at Iyana Ishasi, while the route from Afromedia connecting to Iyana Iba offers a smooth ride.

Vehicular movement atop the Iyana Iba flyover heading towards Mile 2 is uninterrupted, with similar conditions reported underneath the flyover en route to Igando. Free-flowing traffic is observed from Volks to Barracks. The link between Barracks, Abule Osun, and Trade Fair is also good.

Although the Abule Ado main carriageway is busy, traffic is moving steadily. The service lane in that area remains clear and accessible. There are no notable obstructions or impediments across the zone. Our officers are on ground and effectively managing traffic situation.

#FollowLASTMA
